book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Wodhanaas Asaa Maqeteth
Paaziganne ukeththa muussa ba7aale gallassay bonchchettanaas nam7u gallassi attishin qeeseta halaqatinne Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti Yesusa baleththi oykkidi wodhana oge koyida.
Gido attiin, «Asay meto medhdhontta mala ba7aale gallassatan gidoppo» gida.

Izi Bitaaniya geetettizason issi inchchirachcha harganchcha gidida Simoonason quma bolla dishin waagay daro al7o gidida nardoose geetettiza shittoy kumi uttida albasxiroose bilqaaxe oykkida issi maccassaya bilqaaxeza menththada shittoza Yesusa hu7e bolla gussadus.
Heen diza asatappe issi issi asati, «Hayssi shittozi aazas wogay baynda gukkizee?» giidi ba giddon hanqettida.
«Shittozi bayzettidaakko heedzdzu xeetu dinaareppe bollara bayzettidi manqotas imettenneeshin!» giidi maccassayokka kadhida.
Gido attiin Yesusi isttas, «Aggite! Hanno maccassayo aazas waayiseetii? Iza taas lo7o miish ooththadus.
Manqoti ay wodekka inttenara deettes. Intte koyida wode aydekka istta maaddanaas dandayeeta; ta gidikko ubba wode inttenara diikke.
Hanna ba ooththanaas dandayzaari keena ooththadus. Taas moogos gidana mala ta asho kaseta tiyadus.
Ta inttes tumu gays; hayssi Mishiraachcho qaalay alame kumeththaan sabbakettizason awanka iza ooththidayssi izo hassa7issizaaz gididi haasayettana» gides.
Yesusa Aaththi Immanaas Yuhuda Giigeteth
Hessafe guye tammanne nam7atappe issoy Asqoronto Yuhuday Yesusa aaththi immanaas qeeseta halaqataakko bides.
Isttika hessa siyidi ufayettida; izas miishshe immanaas izara giigida; hessa gishshas Yesusa aaththi immanaas injje wode naagishe gam7ides.
Paaziga dorsi shukettiza uketh muussa bonchchiza koyro gallas Yesusa kaallizayti Yesusaakko shiiqidi, «Paaziga kawo maanaso awan giigsana mala koyay?» gi oychchida.
Izikka bana kaallizaytappe nam7ata, «Katama biite; intte bishin haaththe otora tookkida issaadey inttenara gaaggana.
Izi biidi gelizaso gakkanaas iza kaallite. Keeththaadezas, ‹Astamaarey nena, tana kaallizaytara Paaziga kawo maanaas taas gidiza imaththa shemposoy awayssee? gides› giite.
Izikka bolla pooqe bolla diza giigi uttida aahoso inttena bessana; heen izan giigsite» gi kiittides.
Iza kaallizaytikka kezidi katama bida. Wurikka Yesusi gida mala hani beettides; Paazigakka heen giigsida.
Gadey qammishin Yesusi bana kaalliza tammanne nam7atara gakkides.
Istti maaddan dishin, «Ta inttes tumu gays; intte giddofe issoy izikka tanara issife mizayssi tana aaththi immana» gides.
Isttika muuzottidi, «Taneeshaa? Taneeshaa?» giidi issoy issoy Yesusa oychchida.
Izikka isttas, «Tammanne nam7atappe issoy tanara ba kushe keren yeddizaade.
Kase xaafettida mala Asa Nay iza gishshas hayqqana shin asa naa aaththi immizaades aayye ana! Hessaadey kase yelettontta attidaakko izas lo7okkoshin!» gides.
Godaa Kawo Eko Woga
Istti mishin ukeththaa ekki anjjidinne menththidi bana kaallizaytas, «Hayssa ta asho he7ite» gi immides.
Ushshaaka denththi galatidi isttas immiin istti wurikka uyida.
Qasse Yesusi, «Hayssi darota gishshas gukkana ta ooraththa caaqo suuththaa.
Ta inttes tumu gays; ooraththa woyneppe giigida ushshaa Xoossa Kawoteththan ta uyana wode gakkanaas nam7anththo hayssa uyikke» gides.
Hessafe guye mazamure issife yexxidi pude Dabrazayte zuma bolla kezida.
Yesusi, « ‹Ta heemmizayssa shocana; he wode iza dorsati laalettana› geetetti xaafettidayssa mala intte wurikka tanan dhuphettana.
Ta dendidaappe guye gidikko ta inttefe kasetada Galila baana» gides.
Phexroosikka, «Asay wuri dhuphettikokka tani dhuphettike!» gides.
Yesusikka, «Ta nees tumu gays; hach omars kuttoy nam7uto waassana gakkanaas neni tana heedzdzuto kaddana» gides.
Phexroosi qasse, «Ta nenara hayqqizaakkoka mulekka nena kaddike» giidi keehi minththi yootides. Hankkoytikka wuri izayssaththo gida.
Getesemaanen Yesusa Woosa
Hessafe guye Getesemaane geetettizaso bida; Yesusikka bana kaallizayta, «Tani woossishin intte hayssan gam7iishshite» gides.
Phexroosa, Yaaqoobenne Yohannisa banara ekki bides. Keehi qoppidessinne metotides.
Qasseka isttas, «Ta shemppoya daro metotadus intte haan diishshite. Dhiskontta naagite» gides.
Istta achchafe guuth haakki bi biitta bolla gufannidi he saateya izappe aadhdhana mala woossides.
«Ta Aawawu! Nees wuri dandayettees; hayssa waaye xuu7a taappe haassa. Gidikkoka ne sheneppe attiin ta sheney hanoppo» gides.
Izi heeppe simmi yishin iza kaallizayti dhiskidayta be7ides. Phexroosakka, «Simoona dhiskadii? Haray attoshin issi saatekka minnada naagoy nena xoonidee?
Intte paacen gelontta mala beeggidi woossitenne minnite. Ayanay giigetti uttides shin ashoy gidikko daaburanchcha» gides.
Qasseka biidi koyroyssaththo woossides.
Izi nam7anththo simmi yishin istta ayfen dhiskoy deexxiin dhiskidayta demmides shin istti izas ay zaaranakkon eribeettenna.
Heedzdzanththo yiidi, «Ha7ikka intte ichchidi shempeetii? Ha7i gidana; saateyakka gakkadus; hekko Asa Nay nagaranchchata kushen aadhdhi imettana.
Ane eqqite boos; tana aaththi immanaadey yides» gides.
Yesusa Oyketeththinne Aadhdhi Imeteth
Yesusi buro haasayan dishin tammanne nam7atappe issoy Yuhuday yides. Izara issife qeese halaqatappenne Muse wogaa tamaarsizaytappe kiitettida daro asay giththa mashshanne durqqa oykkidi yides.
Iza aaththi immana Yuhuday isttas, «Asa giddofe ta yeerizaadey iza gidida gishshas oykkidi lo7eththi naagi efte» giidi kaseti malata immi woththides.
Gakkida mala Yuhuday Yesusaakko shiiqidi, «Astamaaree!» giidi yeerides.
Asatikka Yesusa oykkida.
Iza achchan eqqida issoy mashsha koohoppe shoddi qeeseta halaqaza ashkara hayth qanxxides.
Yesusikka isttas, «Panga mala tana oykkana mashshanne durqqa oykkidi yeetii?
Wontiin wontiin Xoossa Keeththan tamaarsashe ta inttenara dishin oykkibeekketa shin kase xaafettidayssi polettana mala hayssi hanides» gides.
He wode iza kaallizayti wuri iza yeggi aggi bida.
Ba kalloteth qeeri naxalan kammida issi nay Yesusa kaallishin asay iza oykkiin,
Naazi naxalaa yeggidi kallo kichchides.
Pirda Duulatakko Yesusa Shiiqo
Yesusakka gede qeeseta halaqaakko efida; qeeseta halaqati, dere cimatinne Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti heen issife wuri shiiqida.
Phexroosikka Yesusa haahora kaallishe qeeseta halaqaza gibbe gakkanaas bides. Izi heen uttidi hara asatara tama ho7ishin,
qeeseta halaqatinne dere cimati wuri Yesusa wodhanaas markkattana as koyida shin demmanaas dandaybeettenna.
Daroti iza bolla wordora markkattikokka markkatta qaalay oykettibeenna.
Issi issi markkati dendidi wordora,
«Hayssi addezi, ‹Ta asa kushen keexettida Xoossa Keeththaa laallada asa kushey bochchonttaaz hara heedzdzu gallassara ta keexxana› gishin nu siyidos» gi markkattida.
Gido attiin istta markkateththi issi bolla wodhdhibeenna.
Qeeseta halaqaykka istta sinththan eqqidi, «Hayti ne bolla markkattizayssi aazee? Ne aazas doona zaarikkii?» giidi Yesusa oychchides.
Gido attiin Yesusi isttas aykkoka zaarontta co7u gides; qeeseta halaqay qasseka, «Anjjettida Xoossa Nay Kirstoosi nenee?» gi oychchides.
Yesusikka zaaridi, «Ee; tanakko! Asa Nay wolqqama Xoossa ushachchan uttishininne salo shaarara yishin intte iza beyana» gides.
Qeeseta halaqay ba may7o daakkidi, «Nuus hara aaza markka koshshizee?
Izi cashsha qaala Xoossa bolla haasayshin intte siyideta; ha7ich inttes ay misatizee?» gides. Isttika, «Izas hayqoy bessees» giidi wurikka issi qaalan pirdida.
He wode issi issi asati iza bolla cuch cuttida; iza ayfe goozi oykkidi iccishe, «Ane tinbite yoota» gida. Baggayti qasse shagalan baqqishe efida.
Phexroosi Yesusa Kaddides
Phexroosi duge baggara heen gibbe giddon dishin qeeseta halaqa garadetappe issiniya yadus.
Phexroosi tama ho7ishin tishshi histta xeellada, «Neni Naazirete Yesusara daasa gidikkii?» gadus.
Izi qasse, «Ne gizayssaade ta erikke; ne gizayssi taas gelenna» giidi kaddides. Hessafe gede penge pooqqi eqqi dishin heerakka kuttoy waassides.
He garadeya iza be7ida mala heen eqqida asatas, «Hayssi addezi izara diza asatappe issaadeko!» gaada qasseka haasayadus.
Izi qasseka kaddides. Guuththa wode gam7ishin heen eqqida asati Phexroosa, «Neni Galila asa, hessa gishshas tumappe ne isttafe issaade» gida.
Gido attiin izi qasse, «Intte gizaade ta erikke!» gishe caaqonne bana qanggeth oykkides.
Heerakka kuttoy nam7anththo waassides. Phexroosikka, «Kuttoy nam7aa waassanaas ne tana heedzdzaa kaddana» gida Yesusa qaalay izas qofettiin hiqimi yeekkides.

footnotes.text: Heedzdzu xeetu Dinaare guussi beni wode asas layththa damoza.
